title: Waiting on Wayfair
text: Still nothing from Wayfair. It has been three weeks since the internship ended and the return offer was only verbal. Refreshing my inbox like that will change anything.
summary: You are waiting on a return offer and the silence is wearing on you.

title: Neetcode Grind
text: Did eight problems tonight from the Neetcode 150. Arrays are fine, graphs are not. I keep freezing on anything that needs a traversal.
summary: You are working through interview prep and struggling with graph problems.

title: Morning Routine Holding
text: Up at six, gym before class for the fourth day straight. Legs are wrecked but I got the project scaffolding done after.
summary: You kept your morning routine and made progress on your project.

title: Basketball With Megan and Andy
text: Played pickup with Megan and Andy for two hours, then we got food after. First time in a while I did not think about applications at all.
summary: You spent the day with friends and got a break from job stress.

title: Running Out of Steam
text: Third weekend in a row at the desk. I cannot make myself care about this project anymore and I do not know if that is the project or me.
summary: You are exhausted and losing motivation for your work.
openLoops: decide whether to continue the project

title: Partition Key
text: Four hours debugging a join before Priya pointed out the partition key was wrong the whole time. Embarrassing but she was kind about it.
summary: You lost a day to a bug a colleague spotted immediately.

title: Called Mom
text: Called mom for the first time in a few weeks. She sounded tired but did not want to talk about it. I should visit.
summary: You checked in with your mother and sensed something was off.

title: Clash Royale Ladder
text: Hit a new personal best on ladder tonight. Probably should have been studying but it felt good to be good at something.
summary: You enjoyed a gaming milestone as a break from pressure.

title: Fraternity Recruitment
text: Recruitment starts next week and I said I would run the first round. Not sure what I signed up for but the guys seem excited.
summary: You took on a leadership role for recruitment.

title: Rereading January
text: Went back through my notes from January. I was so much more optimistic then. Not sure whether that is sad or just information.
summary: You reflected on how your outlook has shifted since the start of the year.

title: Demo Went Fine
text: The demo went fine. Nobody asked the question I was dreading and the aggregation numbers held up under scrutiny.
summary: A presentation you were nervous about went smoothly.

title: Could Not Sleep
text: Lay awake turning over the conversation with Marcus about the alerting thresholds. I never followed up and it is going to come back around.
summary: An unresolved work conversation kept you up.
openLoops: follow up with Marcus on alerting thresholds
